components.name: Narrative Primary Action
components.description: Gold monospace action used by narrative scenes.
components.css: .ds-narrative-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-story); padding: 12px 28px; font: 400 15px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-narrative-primary:hover { background: #f2c659; border-color: #f2c659; } .ds-narrative-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Narrative Secondary Action
components.description: Transparent supporting action with warm muted emphasis.
components.css: .ds-narrative-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--color-warm-muted); border: 1px solid rgba(232, 181, 58, 0.65); border-radius: var(--radius-story); padding: 12px 28px; font: 400 15px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-narrative-secondary:hover { background: #f2c659; } .ds-narrative-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Game HUD Capture Control
components.description: Compact, restrained control for releasing keyboard capture outside simulated Herdr.
components.css: .ds-capture-control { background: #141b24; color: #c9d1d9; border: 1px solid #283548; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2.4px 7.2px; font: 400 11px/1.2 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-capture-control:hover { background: #202b3a; border-color: #3b4d66; color: #fff; }

components.name: Herdr Active Tab
components.description: Square active tab using the simulated terminal's blue selection color.
components.css: .ds-herdr-tab { border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-terminal-border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-terminal-chrome); color: var(--color-terminal-muted); padding: 5.6px 14.4px; font: 400 13px/1.2 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-herdr-tab-active { background: var(--color-focus-blue); color: var(--color-terminal-inverse); font-weight: 700; } .ds-herdr-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-focus-blue); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Herdr Focused Pane
components.description: Flat terminal pane with a blue boundary and restrained focus glow.
components.css: .ds-herdr-pane { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #4b5263; border-radius: var(--radius-pane); background: var(--color-terminal-surface); color: var(--color-terminal-text); font: 400 14px/1.55 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-herdr-pane header { padding: 5.6px 12px; background: var(--color-terminal-chrome); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-terminal-border); color: #dcdfe4; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-herdr-pane p { margin: 0; padding: 13.6px 18.4px; } .ds-herdr-pane-focused { border: 2px solid var(--color-focus-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(137, 180, 250, 0.18); }

components.name: Objective Badge
components.description: Compact uppercase gold badge for the active game objective.
components.css: .ds-objective-badge { display: inline-block; background: rgba(232, 181, 58, 0.12); color: var(--color-primary); border: 1px solid rgba(232, 181, 58, 0.35); border-radius: 3.2px; padding: 1.28px 6.4px; font: 700 10px/1.2 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Accessible Navigation Toggle
components.description: Native checkbox paired with the compact accessible-navigation label in the game HUD.
components.css: .ds-access-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4.8px; color: #8b949e; font: 400 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-access-toggle input { margin: 0; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
The visual system follows a stringer through a late investigative shift: rain-dark Capitol scenes establish the thriller, then the surrounding spectacle falls away as the player enters a working terminal. Its voice is tense, cinematic, and investigative; the experience remains a tool, not a decorative control room.

Two registers carry that idea. Narrative scenes use documentary-style Washington imagery, restrained warm action color, and clear system typography. The simulated Herdr workspace uses compact monospace chrome, flat dark surfaces, and blue selection and focus cues. Cooperative mission guidance sits above the terminal as a separate game layer.
keyCharacteristics: Atmospheric, image-led narrative scenes; quiet and legible controls.
Dense, edge-to-edge Herdr workspace with sharp geometry and blue focus.
A distinct mission HUD that does not impersonate terminal chrome.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Keep the cinematic story treatment and the Herdr workspace visually distinct; the game HUD is its own layer.

rules.name: The Gold Is Story Rule
rules.body: Use warm gold for narrative actions and game-mission emphasis, not as a dashboard-like treatment inside the simulated Herdr chrome.

rules.name: The Blue Is Focus Rule
rules.body: Reserve steel blue for active selection and focus in the simulated interface.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep narrative prose in system sans and operational labels and interface text in monospace; do not introduce a third type family.

rules.name: The Flat Terminal Rule
rules.body: Keep resting terminal surfaces flat; use depth only to clarify a focused or floating state.

dos: Do preserve the visual handoff from cinematic narrative scenes to the operational terminal.
Do keep the game mission layer visually identifiable as separate from simulated Herdr.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and use color together with text for state.
Do use the supplied Capitol and workspace images only as illustrative scene-setting.
donts: Don't put rounded dashboard cards or gold panels into the Herdr terminal.
Don't let cinematic effects obscure terminal content or keyboard focus.
Don't present concept artwork as an authentic upstream Herdr visual baseline.
Don't add visual conventions that imply unsupported Herdr behavior.
